name: Award to Scheduled Castes Students Who Secured Top Ranks at State and District Level in Standard X & XII (Sahuji Maharaj Assistance)
briefDescription: Under the scheme, Scheduled Castes Category students who have Secured Top Ranks at State and District Levels in Gujarat in Standard X & XII are given cash prizes. Cash prizes are awarded to the first three students who secure the highest ranks in both Standard X and Standard XII across all streams.
descriptionMd: The scheme “Award to Scheduled Castes Students Who Secured Top Ranks at State and District Level in Standard X &amp; XII” is initiated by the Director Scheduled Caste Welfare, Department of Social Justice &amp; Empowerment, Government of Gujarat. Under the scheme, the Scheduled Castes Category students who have Secured Top Ranks at the State and District Levels in Gujarat in Standard X &amp; XII are given cash prizes. Cash prizes are awarded to the first three students who secure the highest ranks in both Standard X and Standard XII across all streams.
benefitsMd:

eligibilityMd:
1. The students should belong to the Scheduled Castes Category of Gujarat.
   1. The students who have Secured Top Ranks at the State and District Levels in Gujarat in Standard X &amp; Standard XII across all streams are eligible for cash prizes.
   1. There is no income limit.
applicationMd: Under this scheme, the list of students is obtained from the Gujarat Secondary and Higher Secondary Board and the award is given to the selected students accordingly.
